communication_intent.audience_question: 予約サイトのどの操作と分岐を変え、何を測るか？
communication_intent.reading_context: Community workshop booking design proposal, read without a presenter. Japanese adult audience.
communication_intent.dominant_message: 内容と空席をまとめ、登録と確認の独立画面を省く設計目標。

information_structure.description: 内容と空席をまとめ、登録と確認の独立画面を省く設計目標。

required_content: 見出し「迷う操作を、半分に。」
上段の現在案は「8操作」、下段の改善目標は「4操作」
現在案は 一覧 / 詳細 / 日程 / 空席 / 会員登録 / 入力 / 確認 / 完了 の8つ
改善案は 内容と空席 / 日程 / 入力 / 完了 の4つ
資格注記「仮想サイトの設計案。数値は目標値、実測ではありません。」
semantic_relationships: Upper chain is the original eight-step concept; lower chain is the four-step target. The two are alternative flows, not cumulative stages.
evidence: Original fictional booking concept written for this example; no observed analytics.
assumptions: All counts and percentages are targets, not measurements.
open_questions: Actual booking abandonment and user preference to be measured after implementation.
avoid: No logo, no photograph, no false measured-result claim, no card grids.
visual_obligations: Make two spacious horizontal chains with large 8 and 4 at their left. Top chain ink outlined boxes, lower chain cobalt solid rectangles with white labels. Compare the number of required operations, not measured performance.
explicit_user_visual_requirements: Landscape wide slide 1600 × 900, all substantive content safely inside 80px margin. No header/footer/page numbers.
Japanese text exactly as specified; clean heavy Japanese gothic headings resembling Dela, BIZ body. English/Arabic numbers clean geometric sans like Manrope.
Flat ivory background #F7F5EE, ink #112132, vivid cobalt #2B74EE and vermilion #E34F2D. Raster design will be reconstructed with native PowerPoint objects, so only simple flat shapes.

style.visual_language: Flat Japanese editorial diagrams; giant headings, broad whitespace, crisp rectangles and paths. Only meaningful diagram shapes. No photos, no logo, no repeated card grid.
style.whitespace: intentional around the information structure and consistent inside repeated components

non_negotiable_design.icon_slot_rule: For every icon, reserve a visually unambiguous bounded slot that protects its room from surrounding content. The icon may have no designed surface or may sit on a profile-approved background surface. When there is no designed surface, a subtle generation-only boundary may mark the slot for localization; that boundary is scaffolding, not a decorative container and is not reconstructed downstream. When the icon sits on a larger colored panel/card and no distinct icon tile is intended, the downstream reconstruction should keep the icon background transparent rather than turning the scaffold into a white box.

profile.purpose: Create a clear visual argument for fictional booking flow

style.visual_language: Flat Japanese editorial diagrams; giant headings, broad whitespace, crisp rectangles and paths. Only meaningful diagram shapes. No photos, no logo, no repeated card grid.
style.whitespace: intentional around the information structure and consistent inside repeated components

generation_guidance: Use generous whitespace and fewer, larger information groups.
Allow intentionally quiet regions when they strengthen focus and hierarchy.
Do not fill space merely to increase occupancy.
visual_review_guidance: Confirm that empty regions feel intentional rather than unfinished.

generation_guidance: Use the substantive canvas efficiently while retaining clear separation between information groups.
Balance whitespace across the composition rather than leaving one large accidental dead zone.
visual_review_guidance: Reject conspicuous unused peripheral regions that do not support hierarchy.
Keep the page readable without making it sparse or crowded.

generation_guidance: Use the substantive canvas actively with compact, well-structured information groups and strong alignment.
Avoid large isolated blank regions unless they clearly serve hierarchy, pacing, or emphasis.
Prefer expanding, aligning, or redistributing meaningful content before adding decoration.
Keep spacing disciplined and readable; dense does not mean cramped.
visual_review_guidance: Inspect the whole canvas for avoidable dead zones or lopsided whitespace.
Reject a composition that feels under-filled for the selected density even if individual components look good.
Preserve breathing room inside groups while using the overall slide area efficiently.
Judge empty regions by whether they support the argument, hierarchy, or pacing rather than by the semantic type of the nearby element.

ordinary_container.rationale: Generation guidance only. Reconstruction uses the host Agent's observed radius from the accepted image.

asset_placement.generation_slot_policy: When an exact user/current-chat asset is selected, attach it to image generation when possible and ask the selected image-generation model to allocate a compatible, non-distorted slot. The generated depiction is composition guidance; the canonical file is restored downstream.
asset_placement.reconstruction_policy: Restore the exact selected file with contain-fit by default. Never stretch to match a generated placeholder. If the slot is visually incompatible with the intrinsic aspect ratio, the host Agent must revise the logical slot or upstream composition and rerun.

visual_principles: Wide editorial compositions, flat native-friendly geometry and controlled color
anti_patterns: No card grid, no decorative icons, no photographs

resources.selection_reasoning: The content is entirely original abstract booking flows. External publisher templates/photos/logos are excluded; simple geometric relationships and Japanese typography carry the argument.

composition_freedom: Choose the visual composition, grouping structure, exact object placement, connector arrangement, and emphasis system that best communicates the semantic intent.
Do not force a fixed template, grid, card count, chart archetype, component precedent, or one icon treatment when another composition better supports the slide.
Preserve compositional freedom without relaxing resolved design values, profile hard rules, content, asset, or canvas constraints.
Density is a separate user/session control. Apply the selected density inside the profile rather than equating the profile with sparse or dense composition.
